min_date = "2023-05-01"
max_date = "2023-05-31"
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20

    result = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction='received',
        min_created_at=min_date,
        max_created_at=max_date,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    # Check if result is a list (success) or dict with message (failure)

        print("Error:", result)
        break
    all_received.extend(result)
    if len(result) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Number of received transactions this month:", len(all_received))

sender_emails = set()
for txn in all_received:
    sender_emails.add(txn['sender']['email'])
print("Sender emails:", sender_emails)
